name: Comindico
summary: Australia's first IP convergent voice and data carrier, founded 2000; investors AGL, AMP, Consolidated Press Holdings (Packer), JP Morgan, Queensland Press; spent ~$400M (incl. $175M Cisco vendor financing); voluntary administration 23 Sep 2004; receiver McGrathNicol appointed by Cisco 25 Sep 2004.

events.details: Founded in 2000 as Australia's first IP convergent voice and data carrier.
Voluntary administration 23 Sep 2004; Cisco-appointed receivers (McGrathNicol) 25 Sep 2004.
Network and IP-carrier assets acquired from the receivers by SP Telemedia (Soul Communications, Washington H Soul Pattinson group) in late 2004; SP Telemedia later merged into TPG.
source: SP Telemedia / Soul Communications acquisition of Comindico network assets from receiver, Oct 2004 (contemporary press, e.g. AFR/SMH)

refs.label: The Age: Cisco pulls plug on Comindico (25 Sep 2004)
